purpose: Teach: 桐/天狗/ダニ/シティー/飛び込み/海水浴/リハビリテーション/ヘビ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんが桐の箪笥を綺麗にされてたわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandma's been taking such good care of that old paulownia chest.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Soft opening. Speaking as if noticing something small and meaningful. Warm but not performative—the way she mentions what people she loves are quietly doing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと天狗のお祭り行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, can I go to the Tengu Festival with Dad?
lines.style: Bright, direct question. Eager lift on the ask. Small voice but clear intent. The way a six-year-old leans toward something he wants, without performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家のダニ対策を徹底しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, we should really make sure we're keeping the house free of mites, okay?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, caring instruction. Practical tone without heaviness. The voice of someone thinking ahead about his comfort. Slight emphasis on 'really,' like she's thought about this.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとシティーホテルに泊まったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I stayed at a city hotel—it was so cool!
lines.style: Bright, earnest share. Genuine excitement in the middle. No performance, just a small boy who wants her to know something he found wonderful. Slight rise at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとプールで飛び込み練習しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, you should practice diving with Dad at the pool sometime.
lines.style: Warm suggestion, not directive. Gentle lilt on 'diving'—she's imagining it. Soft, encouraging. The voice of someone creating a small, safe moment for him to try something.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、家族で海水浴に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to the beach with our whole family!
lines.style: Bright, open longing. Clear and direct. The 'whole family' carries weight—he's thinking about all of them together. Small voice, big wish.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんがリハビリテーションに通われてるわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa's been going to physical therapy regularly now.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. Slight pause before 'regularly'—she's noticing the effort, the routine. Warm acknowledgment of something ongoing and important. Not heavy, just present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、図鑑でヘビを見て勉強したよ
lines.en: Mom, I studied snakes in my picture book today!
lines.style: Immediate, bright share. Pride and genuine curiosity in his voice. The small laugh of someone who learned something interesting. Direct eye contact in sound—he wants to tell her.
